name: thetechspert Privacy Compliance Tools for UK GDPR
author: thetechspert

sections.description:
thetechspert Privacy Compliance Tools for UK GDPR helps WordPress website owners create and manage key privacy, cookie, complaint and data request processes from inside WordPress.

The plugin is designed for UK small businesses, charities, consultants, agencies, ecommerce stores and WordPress website owners who want a practical way to present privacy information clearly and maintain basic records.

With recent and upcoming UK data protection changes, website owners may need clearer privacy information, a data protection complaint route, data request handling, cookie information and records of consent choices. thetechspert Privacy Compliance Tools for UK GDPR helps you put those essentials in one place.

Features include:

  • Privacy and GDPR Policy page generator
  • Guided setup wizard
  • Cookie banner with visitor preferences
  • Lightweight consent logging
  • Data protection complaint form
  • Subject Access Request / data request form
  • Email opt-out request form
  • Submission logs inside WordPress
  • Snippet examples for forms and collection points
  • Privacy page display modes for hard-coded themes
  • Cookie banner on/off setting
  • Basic colour and content settings

thetechspert Privacy Compliance Tools for UK GDPR is a practical compliance support tool. It does not guarantee legal compliance and should not replace professional legal advice.

Free and Pro

The free version includes the core privacy policy, cookie banner, complaint, data request and opt-out tools.

A Pro version is planned to add advanced tools such as enhanced exports, advanced cookie script loading, richer records, additional snippets and priority support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress plugin directory when available.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. You will be redirected to thetechspert Privacy Tools > Setup Wizard.
  4. Complete the setup steps.
  5. Review the generated Privacy and GDPR Policy page.
  6. Test the complaint, data request and opt-out forms.
  7. Review cookie settings and consent logging.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin guarantee GDPR compliance?

No. The plugin helps website owners create and manage important privacy, cookie, complaint and data request processes, but every business is different and legal advice may still be required.

Does the cookie banner block all scripts automatically?

The free plugin provides a cookie banner and lightweight consent logging. It does not automatically block scripts loaded by other plugins, themes, Google Tag Manager or hard-coded header scripts.

Does it keep records?

Yes. The plugin keeps basic logs of consent choices, complaints, data requests and opt-out submissions.

Does it use SMTP?

The plugin uses the WordPress mail system. For better reliability, users may wish to use an SMTP plugin.

What are the privacy page display modes?

Theme default is safest for most sites. Plugin Default can help with hard-coded themes where normal WordPress content is not shown. Plugin Standalone creates a plain standalone GDPR page without the theme header or footer while still loading WordPress, theme and plugin styles where possible.

Can I turn off the cookie banner?

Yes. The cookie banner can be turned on or off from the plugin settings.

Is there a paid version?

A Pro version is planned with advanced tools such as enhanced exports, advanced cookie script loading, richer records and priority support.
